use: 677.4 nm (air; 677.59 nm vac): open transition used for optical depopulation pumping of the metastable 3s 4P5/2 level (upper level also decays to 3s 4P3/2, which decays to the ground state); measurement of the metastable fraction of a neutralized F beam (Levy et al. 2007)

frequency_source: hyperfine centre of gravity 14581.684 cm^-1 from Liden, Ark. Fys. 1, 229 (1949), as quoted and used for calibration in Levy, Cocolios, Behr, Jayamanna, Minamisono, Pearson, Nucl. Instrum. Methods A 580, 1571 (2007), Table 1 (collinear fast-beam LIF and modulated optical depopulation pumping)
use: 685.6 nm (air; 685.79 nm vac): closed (cycling) transition from the metastable 3s 4P5/2 level; suggested for laser cooling of metastable fluorine (Shimizu et al., Appl. Phys. B 72, 227 (2001)); optical pumping on it demonstrated in a fast F beam for nuclear-spin polarization (Levy et al. 2007); LIF line of the metastable-lifetime measurement (F=3 -> F'=4 component, Shimizu et al. 2006)
761 nm: diode-laser absorption hyperfine spectroscopy (Tate & Aturaliye 1997)
775 nm: diode-laser saturated-absorption hyperfine spectroscopy (Tate & Aturaliye 1997)
780 nm: diode-laser Doppler-free saturated-absorption hyperfine spectroscopy; absolute frequency of one hyperfine component measured against the Rb D2 line (Tate & Aturaliye, PRA 56, 1844 (1997))
